    A standard basic algebra is its projective algebra A₀ #

    Corollary 5.5 (mesh-deformations.tex): "Restrict the resulting isomorphism ind(mod A) ≅ C to the labelled projective objects and take opposite algebras. Construction 2.8 and Proposition 4.14 give A ≅ A₀ ≅ kP."

    For a basic algebra with idempotents e_i, the projective vertices of Γ_A correspond to the e_i (pvEquiv, with S.obj p ≅ e_{σ p} A). A standard equivalence k(Γ_A) ≃ ind(mod A) then gives A₀ = (Alg F₀)ᵒᵖ ≅ (Alg (e_{σ p} A))ᵒᵖ ≅ A (algEquivA0, with the Peirce isomorphism).
